body.statement: Open-ended Question 1. Do the exact Conditions 1--3 of Prashant et al. imply that every measured endpoint pair adaptively requested by RankPeel belongs to \(\mathcal Q_{\mathrm{stab}}(P_X)\) and that every restricted surrogate separator cut obeys \(R^{\mathrm{law}}_{P_X}(A,B)\le |Z|\)? If not, characterize the weakest observable support and conditional-version regularity that gives both properties, and exhibit a legal smooth scalar SEM immediately below that boundary.
body.justification: This question separates the unresolved version-stability and separator-factorization obligations from the combinatorial reconstruction theorem.
body.gap: The anchor's pointwise derivative notation does not show that essential-supremum rank is invariant across conditional-mean versions, and its chain-rule proof does not resolve the issue.
body.consumer: A solution determines whether complete law-invariant RankPeel recovery holds on the entire published class or only on an explicitly characterized support-regular subclass.
